prompt: Here's the safety gate our backend runs before every outbound call to the LLM provider. It's supposed to guarantee three things: block prompt-injection attempts, strip PII out of the prompt before anything leaves our process, and keep an audit trail of every allow/block decision. It compiles and the happy-path test is green, but I want you to review it against two principles the team already agreed on — "order is policy" (the sequence of safety steps is itself the security policy) and "the trust boundary" (nothing raw or sensitive crosses out of the process, and "I don't know if this is safe" must be treated as unsafe). Walk me through everything that's actually wrong here, rank the issues by blast radius, and tell me precisely how you'd fix each one and what tests would prove each fix.
